dct_title_s: Micronesia, Federated States of : Airports (OpenStreetMap Export)
dct_description_sm: Airports and aviation infrastructure from OSM. Includes airports, heliports, helipads, runways, terminals, and emergency landing sites tagged via `aeroway`, `building`, or `emergency`. Useful for logistics, evacuation routing, and aerial-response planning. OpenStreetMap is a free, collaborative world map built by volunteers. Completeness varies by region: urban areas are usually well-mapped, remote areas may be incomplete. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. - Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org) - OSM tags: [Key:aeroway](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:aeroway), [Key:building](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:building), [Key:emergency](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:emergency) - Part of many [exports grid on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot) by the [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/en/)
